experiment: EXPERIMENT (switchable): TANDEM. Two players who run towards or alongside each other within `close` m for `hold` s grab hands and fuse into a tandem for `duration` s: `speed` times as fast, steering is the AVERAGE of both players' inputs, whoever they run into is flung (`shove` times the shove), at the end they spin apart with a fling. Cooldown per pair. Alone, a buddy runs up to the player (`solo_buddy`). Set "on" to false (or a round to false) and the game plays without it. Rules: modes/show/shared/tandem/tandem.gd, docs/party-show.md 'Tandem (experiment)'.
name: TANDEM
